headline: General Motors Aims for AI-Powered 'Eyes-Off' Driving in 2 Years
summary: General Motors is seeking help from artificial intelligence to introduce advanced automated driving features within two years to keep pace with foreign competitors.
why: General Motors is a major US legacy automaker racing to integrate automated driving software to compete with new market entrants.

impacts.name: General Motors
impacts.why: Accelerated AI integration aims to close the technological gap in autonomous driving features.
